pages.title: Deprecating classic
pages.description: Guidance for customers regarding retirement of classic SharePoint pages.
pages.about: This page outlines the upcoming deprecation of classic SharePoint publishing sites, classic user-created pages, and custom scripting in SharePoint Online. It provides a two-phase rollout timeline starting March 2027 and October 2028, with details on what gets disabled at each phase.
changes: New documentation page added covering the full deprecation timeline for classic SharePoint pages and publishing sites
Phase 1 (March 1, 2027): creation of new classic publishing sites disabled, AllowClassicPublishingSiteCreation enforced as False
Phase 2 (October 1, 2028): classic user-created pages become read-only across all existing tenants, DenyAddAndCustomizePages enforced as True
Existing classic page content is preserved and remains viewable but becomes read-only when each phase takes effect

pages.title: Standard storage for unlicensed OneDrive accounts
pages.description: Learn how to manage Standard storage for unlicensed OneDrive accounts, including the tenant-wide active-storage period and per-account reactivation dates.
pages.about: This page explains the Standard storage feature for unlicensed OneDrive accounts, which gives SharePoint admins control over how long unlicensed OneDrive accounts stay active before archiving. It covers pay-as-you-go billing setup, enabling Standard storage, and reactivating archived accounts beyond the default 30-day period.
changes: New documentation page added for Standard storage feature for unlicensed OneDrive accounts
Standard storage will be generally available starting October 2026
Two-step billing setup: connect pay-as-you-go billing via Azure subscription, then enable Standard storage opt-in
Archived content uses Archive meter; active content retained through Standard storage uses Standard meter
Administrators choose which accounts to reactivate — enabling Standard storage does not auto-reactivate all accounts
